value.text: Research the weather in Barcelona for the next two days, then write a one-paragraph packing list based on it.

For your two days in Barcelona, pack for rain on day one and sun on day two. Highs will be about 21°C and 22°C, so it will be mild both days. Bring a compact umbrella and a light waterproof jacket for the wet first day. Wear water-resistant shoes or sneakers that can handle damp streets. For both days, pack breathable layers such as T-shirts and a light sweater or long-sleeve top, plus comfortable pants or jeans. For the sunny second day, add sunglasses, sunscreen, and a hat. A small daypack will help you carry the extra layers and the umbrella as the weather changes.
